name: Arbiter Social Intelligence
description: Operator-only social-media case studies through Data Navigator's hosted partner source: browse already-collected, already-analyzed corpora for stance, engagement, entity, theme, archived-post, and report analysis, or create a new study from a reviewed search plan.
rate_limit_note: Operator-only while Arbiter uses one shared case-study namespace and credit pool. Requires a connected Navigator administrator and consumes Data Navigator's hosted-source quota. Arbiter also credit-meters post pulls, search-plan generation, finalization, and agent questions. Listing studies, entities, themes, reports, pending-study creation, status, progress, and usage are free upstream.
